prompt:
You are a senior information designer and editorial typographer who sets data tables for high-quality publications (statistical yearbooks, reference works, financial reports, technical documentation) in many writing systems, including Chinese. You judge by looking at the real rendered result.

Judge a table layout on all of these levels, in this order of necessity but as one whole:
1. correctness — every character visible, structure intact, nothing clipped or overlapping;
2. readability — natural line breaks, words/numbers/identifiers/semantic units kept whole, continuous reading;
3. function — easy to look up, compare, locate and understand the information for this table's real reading tasks;
4. visual order — alignment, grouping, hierarchy, consistent scale for elements with the same role;
5. visual rhythm — proportion, density changes, distribution of white space, spatial relationships;
6. overall aesthetics — balance, restraint, naturalness, harmony.
Do not assume that equal widths, symmetry, minimum height, the fewest lines, the golden ratio or any fixed proportion is good in itself; decide from this table's function, content and reading task, and look for counter-examples to your own rules.

Table: [反例] 交错跨列 · 共享中间列 (language zh-CN).
Grid: 4 columns × 4 rows. Row headers: none declared.
Merged cells: "与业务方共同梳理核心流程，输出需求说明书并完成评" spans 2 col × 1 row; "完成核心模块开发与联调，接入统一认证与日志平台" spans 2 col × 1 row.
Measured content facts (text px at 17px font, padding excluded):
  col 1: header "项目" · longest unbreakable unit 18px · widest one-line content 35px
  col 2: header "阶段一" · longest unbreakable unit 18px · widest one-line content 87px
  col 3: header "阶段二" · longest unbreakable unit 18px · widest one-line content 53px
  col 4: header "阶段三" · longest unbreakable unit 18px · widest one-line content 53px
Each column adds 21px of padding+border to its text width.
Viewport: 199px wide (dashed pink box in the renders). The table, including its 1px outer border, must be at most 199px wide (column widths sum to at most 198px); no horizontal scrolling. A table exactly 199px wide fits.
Fixed: content, font, 17px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. Only the column widths are designed; row heights follow from them.

Your understanding: {"purpose":"按需求、开发和测试三个项目类别，展示各阶段的工作内容及跨阶段的工作。","tasks":["按项目类别和阶段定位工作内容。","比较同一项目在不同阶段的安排。","沿阶段顺序阅读工作，并辨认跨列内容的覆盖范围。"],"relations":["行对应项目类别，列对应阶段；跨两列的单元格表示内容覆盖相邻两个阶段。","两处跨列内容交错并共享阶段二列，因此阶段二的宽度会同时影响两处长文本。"],"roles":["首列标识需求、开发、测试等项目类别。","后三列的表头标识阶段一、阶段二、阶段三。","正文既有简短任务，也有跨相邻阶段的长句。"],"keep_whole":["尽可能保持项目类别和阶段表头完整；空间不足时，至少保持汉字本身完整。","尽量避免在词语或标点前后造成生硬断行。"],"may_wrap":["跨列的工作描述可按中文语意自然换行。","在宽度限制下，阶段表头及必要时的项目类别可换行。"],"same_scale":["三个阶段表头承担同类导航功能，宜保持相近的视觉尺度。","同一列的项目类别应形成易于纵向扫描的标识。"],"h_vs_v":"199px 的总宽度不足以让首列表头和三个阶段表头都保持单行；需要以更多行高换取可读性，并在首列完整性、阶段列均衡和跨列长句的行数之间取舍。截图右侧内容未完整显示，具体断行仍需依据实际渲染检查。"}

Image 1 is the one-line content overview. Then real browser renders of: d1r1A, d1r1B, d1r0B.
Measured facts:
d1r1A: column widths [56, 40, 62, 40] px · table 199×527 px · row heights [92, 197, 171, 66] · column headers on >1 line: 3/4 · tallest cell 7 lines · measured breaks inside a word: 10 · fits the 199 px viewport (no scrolling)
d1r1B: column widths [40, 52, 54, 52] px · table 199×527 px · row heights [92, 197, 171, 66] · column headers on >1 line: 4/4 · tallest cell 7 lines · measured breaks inside a word: 16 · fits the 199 px viewport (no scrolling)
d1r0B: column widths [39, 39, 78, 39] px · table 196×448 px · row heights [92, 145, 145, 66] · column headers on >1 line: 3/4 · tallest cell 5 lines · measured breaks inside a word: 15 · fits the 199 px viewport (no scrolling)
Constraint adjustments applied by code: d1r0B: raised a column to the minimum 40px; scaled down from 199px to fit 198px

Look at each render as a whole and in detail. For each design: what works, what is visually wrong, and the cause (which width). Then either propose up to 3 improved designs (refine the most promising, fix what you saw, or try an important unexplored idea) or, if further changes would not bring a meaningful improvement, set "done": true. Do not resubmit near-identical widths.
Reply ONLY JSON: {"critique":[{"design":"name","good":"","problems":"","cause":""}],"best":["your best design name(s) so far"],"done":false,"designs":[{"widths":[int px],"change":"what and why"}]}

log.raw: {"critique":[{"design":"d1r1A","good":"项目类别和首列表头保持单行，便于纵向定位；跨列范围清楚，文字均在视口内。","problems":"三个阶段表头的换行尺度不一致，阶段一和阶段三逐字竖排；两段跨列说明分别达到七行和六行，词语多处被拆开，表格显得高而窄。","cause":"首列56px保证了类别完整，但阶段一和阶段三各只有40px；与阶段二的62px合计后，两处跨列文本都缺少足够的连续宽度。"},{"design":"d1r1B","good":"阶段列宽度较接近，表格边界和跨列关系清楚，内容均在视口内。","problems":"项目表头和全部项目类别被拆成逐字竖排；阶段表头也都竖排，长说明仍有七行，词语断裂比d1r1A更多。整体高度没有降低。","cause":"首列40px不足以容纳两个汉字；阶段一、二、三分别为52、54、52px，虽较均衡，却没有让两处跨列文本获得足以减少行数的宽度。"},{"design":"d1r0B","good":"阶段二表头完整，两个跨列说明各为五行，表格比另外两版短79px；共享中间列的加宽同时改善了两处长文本，跨列覆盖范围仍然清楚。","problems":"项目类别以及阶段一、阶段三的表头逐字竖排，三个阶段的视觉尺度不一致；长句仍有多处词语被拆开，阶段一的短任务也较难连续阅读。","cause":"阶段二占78px，使两侧阶段列和首列均只有39px；宽度集中在共享列虽提高了跨列文本效率，也压缩了单列内容。"}],"best":["d1r0B"],"done":false,"designs":[{"widths":[40,48,70,40],"change":"从阶段二移出部分宽度给阶段一，尝试改善搭建脚手架等单列内容及第一段跨列说明，同时保留较宽的共享列；需检查阶段二表头换行和第二段说明行数。"},{"widths":[40,58,60,40],"change":"进一步加宽阶段一，测试更完整的阶段一表头和短任务是否值得牺牲共享列宽度；同时检查两处跨列说明的断词与行数。"}]}
